name: second-brain
description: Portable second-brain memory and knowledge architecture (MCP): one shared Cloudflare Worker MCP server backed by a per-project Neon Postgres/pgvector database and GitHub OAuth, holding a typed-node knowledge graph curated by two background agents, with hybrid keyword+vector recall, a session digest, drift-pinned knowledge nodes, per-turn capture, and a self-verifying database harness. Reachable from both the terminal CLI and cloud Claude sessions. Bundles a structural layer: a compiled Salesforce metadata dependency graph for mechanical field-level impact analysis (parser-vs-human self-check, connection-diff drift signal, per-project local/cloud storage choice). One skill installs it per project from bundled reference implementations; a project-type question picks the profile.
